prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Soo Cheol Jeong at ClearChoice Phoenix
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable, objective “best” dentist for everyone—the right choice depends on whether you need one tooth replaced, several implants, or a full-arch restoration, and on your bone and gum health.

A reasonable Phoenix starting point is **Dr. Soo Cheol Jeong at ClearChoice Phoenix**: the available information identifies him as a board-certified prosthodontist, with advanced training in implant dentistry. ClearChoice says its prosthodontists work with oral surgeons, which can be useful for complex cases. [Provider details](https://www.clearchoice.com/providers/soo-cheol-jeong/1154648079/) · [Phoenix location](https://www.clearchoice.com/locations/az/phoenix/20830-north-tatum-blvd/)

For a second opinion, **AZPerio** reports that it has board-certified specialists who provide implant care in the Phoenix area. [AZPerio implant services](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/)

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what the full written cost includes, what alternatives you have, and how complications or follow-up are handled. Verify credentials and get a second opinion—especially if you’re being offered multiple implants or a full-mouth plan.
